body:
We'll see how Kroger measures up when management reports fiscal second-quarter results before the closing bell on Friday. Wall Street expects EPS of $1.06 (+1.9% YoY) on revenue of $34.61 billion (+2.0% YoY).

Note that Kroger is the only noteworthy publicly traded company scheduled to report earnings on Friday, September 11. [...] ### Monday (9/7)

The stock and bond markets are closed on Monday, September 7, in observance of Labor Day.

There are no noteworthy earnings reports scheduled for release.
